summary: A Yes vote authorizes the district to issue general obligation bonds, repaid by property taxes, to fund school facilities.

tax.text: A Yes vote approves $86 million in locally controlled school funding for school facility repairs and upgrades without increasing tax rates.
tax.quote: If approved by registered voters in the District, without increasing tax rates, Measure B could provide $86 million in locally controlled school funding to:

schools.text: A Yes vote approves funding for repairs, upgrades, safety improvements, and new facilities in Beaumont Unified School District schools.
schools.quote: To make repairs and upgrades to local schools and continue meeting the needs of students, the Beaumont Unified School District Board of Trustees voted to place Measure B, a school facilities improvement bond extension, on the November 3 ballot.

tax.text: A No vote does not approve the bond extension and does not provide its proposed school facility funding.
tax.quote: If approved by registered voters in the District, without increasing tax rates, Measure B could provide $86 million in locally controlled school funding to:

schools.text: A No vote does not approve the proposed bond funding for Beaumont Unified School District schools.
schools.quote: To make repairs and upgrades to local schools and continue meeting the needs of students, the Beaumont Unified School District Board of Trustees voted to place Measure B, a school facilities improvement bond extension, on the November 3 ballot.
